scope: Independent actual controller in Node VM with modeled range value sanitization and real Node Worker integration; no browser rendering or hosted acceptance

checks.name: no automatic Worker, animation, persistence, or numerical results before Run
real concurrent Node Workers complete paired same-input solve and truthful JSON
range value sanitization: completion and longer/shorter branch switching select actual final state
all retained histories render the exact state, residual, dual candidates and diagnostic values
every displayed complex cell and SVG matrix label agrees with current numeric snapshot
initialization is explicitly zero/null and noninterpolated controls visit recorded indices only
candidate threshold and truth reveal change no solver/input and retain all extra candidates
invalid transient threshold during pending results does not cancel solve and recovers export
all generator/solver edits and preset/reset changes invalidate stale exports
silent generator edits, invalid controls and superseded callbacks cannot export stale data
late same-run messages and errors from completed Workers cannot overwrite current result
partial solve, explicit cancel and Worker numerical errors never create a complete export
missing/mismatched modules, constructor, handshake and timeout errors visibly block
malformed final data, false convergence, nonzero initialization and fake history are rejected
real iteration-limit preset preserves paired max_iter and export stopping evidence
static evidence claims, artifact sources and accessibility/responsive hooks remain bounded
checks.note: Static hooks only; visual layout, keyboard behavior, contrast and hosted delivery require browser acceptance
